articles.title: Flying Cows and Smart Drones: How Phone Companies Get Ready for Hurricanes
articles.summary: Imagine a drone named HAWK carrying a cell tower through the sky! Phone companies are using AI, drones, and even boats to keep you connected during hurricanes. They plan a week ahead so you can text your family when the power goes out.

articles.title: The Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool Just Got a Bold New Paint Job — and Not Everyone Is Happy
articles.summary: The famous Reflecting Pool in Washington, D.C., has been painted a deep “American flag blue.” President Trump says it cost up to $2 million, but records show over $14 million in contracts. Critics say it looks like a swimming pool and sued to stop it.

articles.title: Trump Wants to Spend $700 Million to Bring Back Coal Power — But Is That a Good Idea?
articles.summary: President Trump is about to announce a $700 million plan to help coal plants and build new ones — the first since 2013. Supporters say it will create 14,000 jobs. Critics say it will make electricity more expensive and the air dirtier.
